function: Excluded (function): the learned method performs user localization, not one of the seven areas. p. 3: "The considered task is the localization of a single-antenna UE"; p. 1 abstract: "extends the well-established fingerprinting-based localization framework".
notes: Reason: function (Step 1, rule 5), localization is listed as an excluded function. The trained network f_theta (9.1M parameters, p. 4) maps location to channel and is used as a generative database for fingerprinting localization (p. 5, Definition 3: x_hat = argmin ||H(x) - f_theta(x)||_F, solved by grid search and gradient descent). The performance metric is the localization error, with median, 10% and 90% quantiles (defined pp. 8-9, plotted in Fig. 8 on p. 10), with inference time (Table II, p. 11) and memory (p. 11) as cost measures; the channel NMSE of f_theta appears only as a diagnostic against localization error (p. 11, Fig. 11). Learning is present, so no_learning does not apply. Channel synthesis would be area 2 for the earlier paper [10] that introduced f_theta, but in this paper the evaluated problem is localization. Setup for the reviewer: 64-antenna ULA base station, single-antenna UE, no RIS, 3.5 GHz, Sionna ray tracing (p. 8). A reviewer may confirm that the generative channel model does not make this an area 2 work.
